ASAN_policy: Compiler children cap hard+soft AS at4GiB; never import/call main() in owner. Runtime is a fresh independent process from an unlimited-AS owner, leaks ON; no retry/disabled leaks.
S11_closure_and_publication_reference: VERIFIED_S11_40HEX_REQUIRED_FROM_ROOT; S12 prep commit5e5f929 is not this closure reference.
command_hash_rules: argv_template_sha256 hashes canonical JSON argv with placeholders. After exact root grant/S11 replacement capture and hash actual argv separately; never relabel template hash as actual command.
controller_policy: NO new generic controller or scheduler. Each selected frozen CLI is a separate process using existing S11/S09 owned transport; launch one explicit stage at a time with the existing one-shot parent pattern.
owner: /root/s12_publication_prep is designated S12 native owner only after root grants it
scope: Frozen six-file S12 v2 patch only. No S11 candidate/material producer, timing, training, SPRT, Elo or acceptance.
